_comment: Hand-minimized from the counterexample found by TestPropertyUncoupledStability/preferred_probe on 2026-07-04 (the auto-saved rapid shrink lands in failing-uncoupled-stability.json). Scenario class: a pod whose ONLY constraint is a ScheduleAnyway zonal topology spread whose selector matches RUNNING pods. The classifier marks preferred-only pods Uncoupled (classify.go, ReasonPreferredOnly), but the reused scheduler honors ScheduleAnyway spread against the domain counts until preference relaxation: nextDomainTopologySpread narrows the claim to a SINGLE min-count zone, tie-broken by randomized Go map iteration. Occupancy A (no matching running pods) draws its zone from {zone-1, zone-2, zone-3}; occupancy B (two matching running pods on zone-1) can only draw from {zone-2, zone-3}, so the fingerprints differ unless the draws coincide (~2/3 of runs fail). Invariant .16 violation of the 'classifier under-marks coupled pods' kind, compounded by the same nondeterministic domain tie-break behind minimized-empty-cluster-bound.json.
